subject: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge

Team — quick summary and ask for executive prep. NimbusOps hit a sustained throughput shortfall and intermittent 5xx spikes starting 2027-01-12 03:00 UTC, impacting their core customer-facing flows (authentication and live scoring). Their CS lead is on an urgent exec thread and has requested a board-level remediation plan plus a commercial proposal for credits.

What we know:
- Incident window: ~48 hours of degraded throughput with peak 5xx rate ~6% (normally <0.1%).
- Affected model routes: text-gen-large and reranker; overall token processing reduced by ~40% at peak.
- Customer impact: page errors for premium customers and queueing delays for queued requests.

Immediate asks:
1) Monica — please draft a commercial offer (credits + interim uplift) keyed to the usage delta and include a proposed contract amendment.
2) Karthik — I need a short tech remediation plan we can attach (capacity uplift, temporary scaling knobs, and fallbacks) and an estimate for how quickly we can restore normal throughput with burst capacity.
3) Laura — once we have commercial wording and tech timeline, escalate to finance + legal for signoff; this will need an exec approval path.

Audience: NimbusOps execs, our Revenue Ops and Legal. We have an impending ask for a firm credit number and an interim capacity uplift within 24 hours. I'm attaching the incident_summary.pdf that CS shared.

Jordan Blake
VP, Customer Success (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: incident_summary.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge

Thanks Jordan — drafting now. Early commercial framing:
- Interim uplift: grant immediate burst capacity for 72 hours at no extra charge (we can route to dedicated pool).
- Credit framework: propose a tiered credit model tied to token shortfall and error windows; initial proposal is 30% credit on net token spend for affected routes during the incident window.
- Contract amendment: simple one-page addendum agreeing to the uplift and credit calculation, plus a clause for retrospective audit.

I'll attach a working sheet with the credit calc for review (credit_proposal.xlsx). Karthik — need your estimate by EOD for expected recovery time if we enable burst and apply configuration X/Y.

Monica Patel
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit_proposal.xlsx

On Fri, Jan 15, 2027 at 09:12 Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — quick summary and ask for executive prep. NimbusOps hit a sustained throughput shortfall and intermittent 5xx spikes starting 2027-01-12 03:00 UTC...
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbusops.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@nimbusops.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 12:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge

Jordan / Monica / Karthik — thanks for the quick heads-up and the incident summary. To be explicit on our side: this incident caused failed responses for several enterprise customers, and our revenue ops team estimates potential MRR impact if not made right.

Two immediate asks from NimbusOps:
1) We need an immediate burst capacity uplift while you remediate — 48 hours minimum — to stabilize customer traffic.
2) A commercial credit that reflects lost customer conversions; our finance team suggested starting negotiation at 50% credit on charges for affected routes during the incident window pending your calculation.

I'll share a brief impact packet from our side (routing logs and aggregated revenue impact) to contracts@nimbusops.com after this thread. We'd like an exec-to-exec call if possible Monday morning PST.

—Alex Chen
Head of Platform
NimbusOps
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbusops.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, contracts@nimbusops.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge

Alex — appreciate the clarity. We can commit to the immediate uplift (48–72 hours) starting now; I'll flag ops to trigger the dedicated burst pool. On credits, Monica's initial is 30% which is our baseline offer; given your ask for 50% we can meet in the middle with a structured approach:

Proposal (quick):
- Immediate: 72-hour burst capacity at no charge.
- Commercial: 40% credit on net charges for affected routes during the defined incident window (we'll share the calculation and logs to make the window auditable).
- Addendum: one-page contract amendment for the uplift and the credit, with a joint audit clause and SLA remediation plan.

I'll schedule an exec call Monday 2027-01-18 16:00 UTC (08:00 PST) — include your execs and our Revenue + Legal. Link: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/XYZ-12345 (placeholder for the amendment).

Jordan Blake
VP, Customer Success (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbusops.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 07:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge

Quick technical note for the record and for the amendment:
- Root cause (preliminary): suboptimal routing to GPU pool during a configuration rollout; a fallback path for small-batch requests was disabled inadvertently.
- Immediate mitigation applied: enabled dedicated burst pool + reinstated fallback path (started 2027-01-16 03:10 UTC).
- Expected recovery: 6–12 hours to observe traffic normalization after burst; full regression testing and a safe rollback strategy takes ~48 hours.
- Recommended durable remediation: add a configuration guard and an automated canary for routing changes; will propose a change-control addendum.

I've attached the usage dump and a short calc for throughput impact (usage_analysis.csv). This supports the credit calc Monica prepared.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_analysis.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimbusops.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbusops.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 17:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Board-level ask: commercial resolution & patch plan for NimbusOps token surge

Confirming next steps from Finance/Legal side:
- Finance will accept the 40% credit framework pending joint audit of logs (we need the log slice and the audited window).
- Legal can prepare a short-form amendment for signature; will use the DocuSign room Jordan shared.
- Exec call scheduled for Monday stands — I'll bring our Head of Revenue Operations and Legal Counsel.

Alex — please send the impact packet to contracts@nimbusops.com and include the specific customer IDs affected so we can align the audit. Once the audit window is agreed, we'll route the amendment for signature and finish the uplift reconciliation.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
